title: Synthesis and structure activity relationship of the first class of LXR inverse agonists.
authors: Elgendy, Bahaa; Griffett, Kristine; Hegazy, Lamees; Di Fruscia, Paolo; Sample, Kirby; Schoepke, Emmalie; Kamenecka, Theodore M; Burris, Thomas P
one_liner_zh: 该文研究LXR核受体的反向激动剂合成与构效关系，虽用MD模拟但对象为核受体-小分子，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Liver X Receptors (LXRs) are members of the nuclear receptor family, and they play significant role in lipid and cholesterol metabolism. Moreover, they are key regulators of several inflammatory pathways. Pharmacological modulation of LXRs holds great potential in treatment of metabolic diseases, neurodegenerative diseases, and cancer. We were the first group to identify LXR inverse agonists SR9238 (6) and SR9243 (7) and demonstrate their potential utility in treating liver diseases and cancer. Here, we present the results of structure-activity relationship (SAR) studies, based around SR9238 (6) and SR9243 (7). This study led to identification of 16, 17, 19, and 38, which were more potent inverse agonists than SR9238 (6) and SR9243 (7) and inhibited expression of the fatty acid synthase gene in DU145 cells. We previously demonstrated that inhibition of FASN is correlated to the anticancer activity of SR9243 (7) and this suggests that new inverse agonists have great potential as anticancer agents. We identified compounds with distinct selectivity toward both LXR isoforms, which can be excellent tools to study the pharmacology of both isoforms. We employed molecular dynamic (MD) simulations to better understand the molecular mechanism underlying inverse agonist activity and to guide our future design.
abstract_zh: 肝X受体（Liver X Receptors, LXRs）是核受体家族的成员，在脂质和胆固醇代谢中发挥重要作用。此外，它们还是多种炎症通路的关键调节因子。对LXRs的药理学调节在治疗代谢性疾病、神经退行性疾病和癌症方面具有巨大潜力。我们是首个鉴定出LXR反向激动剂SR9238 (6) 和SR9243 (7) 的研究团队，并证明了它们在治疗肝脏疾病和癌症中的潜在应用价值。在此，我们展示了基于SR9238 (6) 和SR9243 (7) 的结构-活性关系（structure-activity relationship, SAR）研究结果。该研究鉴定出化合物16、17、19和38，它们比SR9238 (6) 和SR9243 (7) 具有更强的反向激动剂活性，并抑制了DU145细胞中脂肪酸合酶基因的表达。我们先前证明，FASN的抑制与SR9243 (7) 的抗癌活性相关，这表明新的反向激动剂作为抗癌药物具有巨大潜力。我们鉴定出对两种LXR亚型具有显著选择性的化合物，这些化合物可作为研究两种亚型药理学特性的优秀工具。我们采用分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟来更好地理解反向激动剂活性背后的分子机制，并指导未来的设计。
